fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: A visa is required to enter Afghanistan.
entry.es: Se necesita visado para entrar en Afganistán.
entry.quote: A visa is required to enter Afghanistan.

entry.en: Afghan authorities may ask for a polio vaccination certificate on departure.
entry.es: Las autoridades afganas pueden pedir un certificado de vacuna contra la polio a la salida.
entry.quote: On your departure, the Afghan authorities may ask for a certificate to prove you’ve had a polio vaccine.

entry.en: It is illegal to carry more than 5000 US dollars in cash through airports and more than 500 US dollars through land borders.
entry.es: Es ilegal llevar más de 5000 dólares en efectivo por aeropuertos y más de 500 por fronteras terrestres.
entry.quote: It is illegal to carry more than 5000 US dollars through airports and more than 500 US dollars through land borders in cash.

safety.en: The FCDO advises against all travel to Afghanistan, even as part of an organised tour group.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a Afganistán, incluso en un grupo organizado.
safety.quote: The FCDO advises against all travel to Afghanistan, even if you are part of an organised tour group.

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Afghanistan.
safety.es: Es muy probable que terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Afganistán.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Afghanistan.

safety.en: There is a very high threat of being kidnapped in Afghanistan.
safety.es: Existe una amenaza muy alta de secuestro en Afganistán.
safety.quote: There is a very high threat of being kidnapped in Afghanistan.

safety.en: The Taliban has a very low tolerance for demonstrations and for activities perceived as dissent.
safety.es: Los talibanes tienen muy poca tolerancia hacia las manifestaciones y las actividades percibidas como disidencia.
safety.quote: The Taliban has a very low tolerance for demonstrations and for activities perceived as dissent.

safety.en: Foreign nationals' activities are viewed with suspicion by the authorities.
safety.es: Las actividades de los extranjeros son vistas con sospecha por las autoridades.
safety.quote: Foreign nationals’ activities are viewed with suspicion.

health.en: Only very limited medical facilities are available in Afghanistan.
health.es: En Afganistán solo hay instalaciones médicas muy limitadas.
health.quote: Only very limited medical facilities are available in Afghanistan.

health.en: There are serious shortages of some medicines in Afghanistan.
health.es: Hay graves escasez de algunos medicamentos en Afganistán.
health.quote: There are serious shortages of some medicines in Afghanistan.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Afghanistan.
health.es: La enfermedad de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de Afganistán.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Afghanistan.

health.en: Wikivoyage advises hot, freshly cooked food and bottled water unless you have your own purification system.
health.es: Wikivoyage aconseja comida caliente y recién cocinada, y agua embotellada salvo que tengas tu propio sistema de purificación.
health.quote: Hot, freshly cooked food is generally safer. Bottled water is also advised, unless you have your own purification system.

help.en: The police emergency number in Afghanistan is 119.
help.es: El número de emergencias de la policía en Afganistán es el 119.

help.en: There is no British Embassy in Afghanistan and FCDO's ability to help British nationals is severely limited and cannot be delivered in person.
help.es: No hay embajada británica en Afganistán y la ayuda del FCDO a ciudadanos británicos es muy limitada y no puede darse en persona.
help.quote: There is no British Embassy in Afghanistan and our ability to provide help to British nationals is severely limited and cannot be delivered in person.

getting_in.en: Kabul International Airport is the main entry point and the only one allowed when entering on an eVisa.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de Kabul es el principal punto de entrada y el único permitido con eVisa.
getting_in.quote: Kabul International Airport (KBL IATA) in Kabul is the main entry point to the country and the only one allowed when entering on an eVisa.

getting_in.en: The Mashhad (Iran) to Herat border is open to foreigners.
getting_in.es: La frontera de Mashhad (Irán) a Herat está abierta a extranjeros.
getting_in.quote: From Mashad, Iran to Herat, in the west. This border is open to foreigners.

getting_in.en: The Termez (Uzbekistan) to Mazar-e Sharif border is open to third-country nationals.
getting_in.es: La frontera de Termez (Uzbekistán) a Mazar-e Sharif está abierta a nacionales de terceros países.
getting_in.quote: From Termez, Uzbekistan to Mazar-e Sharif, in the north. This border is open to third-country nationals.

getting_in.en: The Quetta (Pakistan) to Kandahar crossing is closed to third-country nationals.
getting_in.es: El paso de Quetta (Pakistán) a Kandahar está cerrado a nacionales de terceros países.
getting_in.quote: From Quetta, Pakistan, to Kandahar, in the south. This crossing is closed to third-country nationals.

getting_around.en: Ariana Afghan Airlines and Kam Air both operate flights between Kabul, Herat, Mazar-i-Sharif and Kandahar.
getting_around.es: Ariana Afghan Airlines y Kam Air operan vuelos entre Kabul, Herat, Mazar-i-Sharif y Kandahar.
getting_around.quote: Flag carrier Ariana Afghan Airlines and  Kam Air both operate flights between Kabul, Herat, Mazar-I-Sharif and Kandahar.

getting_around.en: Street-hail taxis do not use meters, so you must agree a flat fare with the driver before getting in.
getting_around.es: Los taxis que se paran en la calle no usan taxímetro, por lo que hay que acordar una tarifa fija con el conductor antes de subir.
getting_around.quote: Street-hail taxis still do not utilize meters, requiring passengers to negotiate and agree on a flat fare with the driver before entering the vehicle.

getting_around.en: Over 90% of Afghanistan's roads are dirt or gravel tracks vulnerable to seasonal weather.
getting_around.es: Más del 90% de las carreteras de Afganistán son pistas de tierra o grava vulnerables al clima estacional.
getting_around.quote: Over 90% of Afghanistan's roads consist of local dirt or gravel tracks that are highly vulnerable to seasonal weather

money.en: The Afghani (AFN) is the currency of Afghanistan.
money.es: El afgani (AFN) es la moneda de Afganistán.
money.quote: The Afghani (AFN) is the currency of Afghanistan

money.en: Foreign currencies such as US dollars may not be used for domestic transactions; daily purchases must be paid in afghanis.
money.es: No se pueden usar divisas extranjeras como dólares en transacciones locales; las compras diarias deben pagarse en afganis.
money.quote: Local financial regulations strictly prohibit the use of foreign currencies like US dollars or Pakistani rupees for domestic transactions, requiring all daily retail purchases to be settled exclusively in local afghanis

etiquette.en: Refusing the tea, sweets, snacks and gifts offered in an Afghan home can leave a bad impression on your hosts.
etiquette.es: Rechazar el té, dulces, tentempiés y regalos que se ofrecen en un hogar afgano puede dar mala impresión a los anfitriones.
etiquette.quote: Don't refuse any of these as it can leave a bad impression on your hosts.

etiquette.en: Do not photograph or record people without their permission, especially women.
etiquette.es: No fotografíes ni grabes a personas sin su permiso, especialmente a mujeres.
etiquette.quote: do not photograph or record people without their permission, especially women.

etiquette.en: Losing your temper is seen as disrespectful in Afghanistan.
etiquette.es: Perder los estribos se considera una falta de respeto en Afganistán.
etiquette.quote: Losing your temper is seen as disrespectful

connectivity.en: SIM cards are available, and Roshan is described as the most reliable service in the Kabul area.
connectivity.es: Hay tarjetas SIM disponibles, y Roshan se describe como el servicio más fiable en la zona de Kabul.
connectivity.quote: SIM cards are available and international calls to Europe/US typically cost less than USD0.5/minute.

connectivity.en: Authorities have periodically cut or restricted high-speed internet and telecommunications in several provinces.
connectivity.es: Las autoridades han cortado o restringido periódicamente internet de alta velocidad y las telecomunicaciones en varias provincias.
connectivity.quote: The authorities have periodically cut off or restricted high-speed fiber-optic internet and telecommunications in multiple provinces
